text:
alice: Final launch bulletin draft ready for review — aiming for Fri 16:00 UTC. Need a pin, canary lanes, and rollback criteria in the internal blurb. Quick sync?
ben: I can own pinning + canary matrix. Where's the staging build tag?
claire: staging tag is release/2026-03-26-candidate, pushing final acceptance tests now.
ops-lee: Noted the 16:00 UTC window. Ops will reserve 16:00-17:00 for potential rollback. If deploy-bot reports >3% errors or p95 latency spikes, we'll hit the stop button.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued for tag=release/2026-03-26-candidate -> env=staging at 2026-03-26T16:00:30Z. Status: queued.
devex-sam: Internal blurb draft: "Heads-up: We'll ship the new inference routing + optimizations Fri 16:00 UTC. You may see temporary rate-limiting on /v1/generate; model pinning will be applied. If you have live traffic dependencies, please pause writes to inference config until 17:00 UTC. Contact #eng-oncall for incidents." Thoughts?
alice: Nice. Add explicit pin: model routing pinned to r-infer-v2.3. Fallback policy: if performance regresses, fallback to r-infer-v2.2 automatically.
ben: I'll add the rollout policy: 10% canary -> 50% -> 100% over ~20m. Auto-rollback triggers: >200% increase in error-rate OR p95 latency >200ms for 5m. Also include a manual rollback step for ops.
claire: Updated release-notes in the doc and pushed staging checklist: <https://git.internal/releases/8239|release doc> — tests green.
alice: :eyes: Ben, can you own the rollback runbook steps (explicit commands + where to check metrics)? Need step-by-step in the runbook.
ben: Yep. Quick ops snippet for rollback: `deploybot rollback --service inference --to-tag=release/2026-03-25-stable` — will also clear model pin so routes fall back. I'll expand into the runbook.
ops-lee: Question: do we have per-route pinning? We must keep embeddings on stable r-embed-v1.0 to avoid perf regressions in downstream infra. If route-level pins aren't set, embeddings could be flipped and we'd block the release.
devex-sam: Console note to add: "Pinned routing: embeddings -> r-embed-v1.0; generation routes -> r-infer-v2.3 (canary then full rollout)."
alice: Good catch. Claire, can you confirm the deploy pipeline respects route-level pins?
claire: Yes — the deploy pipeline reads route pins from routing-config and applies at release time. Confirmed embeddings remain pinned.
alice: Final ask: short internal announce copy (one-paragraph). Draft below, feel free to shorten: 
"Heads-up: Friday 16:00 UTC we will roll out the inference routing update (r-infer-v2.3) to hosted and dedicated. Expect a staged rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with automatic rollback on performance regressions. Embeddings will remain pinned to r-embed-v1.0. Please avoid editing inference configs during 16:00-17:00 UTC. If you observe issues, ping #eng-oncall or /call oncall."
ben: Looks good — suggest adding a link to the runbook and the rollback command.
alice: Good. I'll add links and send the internal announce at T-45m. Everyone ok with that?
devex-sam: :thumbsup:
ops-lee: 👍 ready on ops side, standby oncall.
claire: pushing final tag now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-03-26T16:01:00Z -> env=canary. Monitoring: metrics pipeline connected.
alice: Thanks team — I'll post the internal announce and pin the release doc once canary looks stable.
ben: I'll monitor metrics and post roll-forward or rollback recommendation in this thread.
ops-lee: If we need to abort, use the manual abort flow: `deploybot abort --stage=canary --service=inference` and then run the rollback snippet above.
claire: FYI I left a short checklist in the doc for oncall (where to check p95, error rate, and prefix cache stats).
alice: Perfect. Closing loop here; will post announce soon.
